page.layout: One column of running text, with a small diagram of letters and brackets set inside the paragraph about the moving body. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: detur profecto ista albedo, quæ est accidens, prorsus quemadmodum diuiditur illud corpus cui inhærét:) ita & motus partium simul fieri intelligetur, quemadmodum fit motus totius rei mobilis.
main_text.head: Quomodo distinguitur motus secundum partes rei mobilis à motu secundum tempus?
main_text.p: Hoc pacto: Quando diuiditur motus secundum partes rei mobilis, ipsæ partes simul manent: quando vero diuiditur motus secundum tempus, tum partes non manent simul. Si tamen motus partis unius comparetur ad partem alterius, non simpliciter, sed secundum certum aliquod signum, ad quod fit motus, sanè hic motus unius partis etiam tempore præcedet motum alterius. c Sumatur (uerbi gratia) res mobilis A ⌐——⌙——⌐ B. & moueatur in G magnitudine E ⌐——⌙——⌐ F. ita ut magnitudo E G æqualis sit toti A B. manifestum fit, quòd signum G prius pertransibit C B, quàm A C. quo quidem pacto simul deprehenditur ibi motus secundum partes temporis, & secundum partes rei mobilis.
main_text.head: Potestne motus ita diuidi, ut non etiam aliæ res simul diuidantur?
main_text.p: Non potest. Quando enim omne quod mouetur, necessum [?]

page.notes: The diagram in the paragraph beginning "Sumatur": brackets join A to B and E to F, with G printed between the two lines above the second bracket. Brackets are shown here only as approximate symbols. A stray mark "i" stands at the left of the last line, below "mouetur"; it is not a catchword and is not transcribed. The word "necessum" is read from a worn ligature and is marked [?]. The heading "Potest' ne" has an apostrophe after "Potest" as printed. No catchword or signature is visible at the foot.
